content: Xasemehena, nohinaeharenae, kasani Israel hotyali waiyexe maniya kaiyakeheta naokita. Hatyo hiyeta Enore hiye niraexaita etahiha.
Enore koamaniya xakore atyo tyaona aokowiyahitaha hoka maisa atyo Enore koamaniya nawenatyakaho kakoa waiyorahitaha. Hatyoharenae waiyekehalakita nomani.
Maisa waiyekehalakere enomanaha Enore aokiterehare haliti haomana akiti kakoa hoka tyaonahitaha haxahekolaha ximita. Maisa waiyeta enomanaha Enore aokiterehare haliti haomana.
Hiyaiya, Cristo atyo xaotyakiyaho kamiyanetya, hoka tyotya tyakekohenerenai haliti waiyexe aoka maheta.
Waiyexe Maniya Nawenatyaka Atyo Tyotya Halitinae Anere
Moisés atyo exakerexe xairatya Enore aokitere haliti haomana tahi akiti, Xaotyakiyaho xema tyaonitere hiyeta:

content.text: Xala xamani atyoite Xaotyakiyaho aokitere akereta taita tyaona hoka tyaota mene atyoite.

content: Xakore hoka nexa atyo Enore aokitere haliti haomana ityakekone hiyeta akiti: “Awa atyo hisota haxoawi: Xalaite enokoa xeta xanehena?” Exakerexe atyo exe akiti: “Xalaite xane enokoata Cristo nolohetehena?” nita atyo.
Awa atyo exakere hekoti haxehena: “Xalaite exoahena toloko hatekoakore?” Exakerexe atyo exe akiti: “Xalaite xane kolahetehena Cristo kamatinae tyaonitere nalita?” nita atyo.
Exakere atyo nexa: “Enore niraene atyo hihaliya tyaonita, hikanasako, himahiyasako xoaha”. Exe Iraiti wiyakaihenere atyo katyakekotyaka maheta.
“Notyakekota Xekohaseti Jesus”, hexaiya hiraeta hikanase kakoa, exahe hityakeko kaiserehare, Enore ekasekihetehenerene xoaha akiti hoka waiyexe maniyaiya hikaiyakeheta.
Hiyaiya, wityakekota kaiserehare atyo hoka haliti waiyexe Enore aokita wiso. Wikanase kakoa atyo wiraeta wityakekone tahi hoka waiye maniya wikaxomokakihitita.
Hiyaiya, exakere atyo Iraiti Waiyexe nexa:

content.text: Xala xamani atyoite tyakekone hoka maisaiya maihalahareneta ekakoa, nexa.

content: Tyotya haliti hotyalinae xaokaka atyo nikare iraeta. Hiyaiya, judeunae, majudeuneharenae xoaha atyo maisa hawareharexeha makere xini. Enore atyo tyotya haliti Xekohase, exahe waiye mokita hoka xalanae xamani hakahinaetyaka aokita ihiyeta hoka kahinaetyahitene.
Hiyaiya, exakere atyo Iraiti Waiyexe xairatyoare tyaonita:

content.text: Xala xamani atyoite hakahinaetyaka aoka Enore hiye hoka waiyexe maniyaite kaxomokakeheta, nexa.

content: Hoka aliyakereya axehenaha, maisa xakore tyakekorahene hoka? Hoka aliyakereya tyakekohenahene, maisa xakore iraiti semareha hoka? Hoka aliyakereya semehenaha Iraiti xakore, maisa xalahare xakaiye ihiyeha hoka?
Hoka aliyakereya xakaihenaha, maxaxikatyakahare iraiti xakaisaseharenai hoka? Hiyaiya, exakere atyo Iraiti Waiyexe nexa:

content.text: “Waiye kaiserehare atyo iraiti xakaisaseharenai kaokehetehena hoka waiyexe tahi xakaihakahenaha hoka”, nexa.

content: Xakore hoka maisa atyo tyotyaha tyakekoreha Iraiti Waiyexe. Isaías exakere irae: “Xekohaseti, xala tyakeko Iraiti Waiyexe wiyakaihenere?” nexa.
Nikare tyakekoti kaotyaka Iraiti semaka hiyeta, exahe Iraiti atyo kaotyaka Cristo tahi kaxakaisakitere hiyeta.
Hoka natyo atyo naxita: Xoana maisa ala semahitaha Iraiti tahi? Koxaka atyo semaha Iraiti. Exakere Iraiti Waiyexe nexa:

content.text: “Tyotya waikohekoa, tyotya wenakalatinaekoa tyaoniterenae semaha iniraeneha, exahe seko akiya tyaoniterenae hoka semahene”, nexa.

content: Hoka naxehitiyaite: Xoana Israel hotyalinai anala maisa exeharenae waiyekehalakita? Hiyaiya, Moisés hotohare atyo nexa:

content.text: “Naokoawahalinikisaite xiso halitinai hahotyalita mawenaneharenai hiyeta, exahe naxehalinikisaite xiso halitinai mawaiyoreharenai hiyeta”, nexa.

content: Isaías maisa mairita hekoti hoka nexa:

content.text: Haiyaharenae xakore atyo maisa Enore tawareha hoka ekoamaniya tyaonaha, exahe maisa xakore axareha etahi akiti hoka kaotyaka enomanaha, nexa.

content: Hoka exakere atyo Isaías nexa Israel hotyali tahi:

content.text: Fera nokahe naimatya exe halitinae masemaxemalaharenai, matyakekoneharenae ana hoka maiha terota, nexa.
